Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: Instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe Canada order book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. Distributed in rare recovery events such as a data center fail-over.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: Instrument Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminates information for each symbol. A separate Trading Status message indicates the status of each symbol. If no Trading Status message is received for a symbol, it is assumed to be Suspended.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Allowed Book Types
Field.Description: Defines the order book types allowed for the symbol. Each designated bit represents a book type. 0 means not allowed and 1 means allowed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the symbol is assigned to (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: The possible values will be the ISO 4217 codes for currency.

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the minimum quantity/nominal value tradable on the market for a security.

Field.Name: Full Name
Field.Description: The unique long name assigned to the symbol.

Field.Name: Active Market Maker
Field.Description: The active market maker broker id who will be carrying our market maker obligations for the instrument.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The security type of the instrument.

Field.Name: Instrument Flags
Field.Description: Instrument flags bit field.

Field.Name: Previous Close
Field.Description: The previous day's closing price.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: Indicates the current trading status of a security on the Cboe Canada NEO system. Sequenced Trading Status messages are sent upon system startup for all active securities with Trading Status = S (suspended).

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated. Only the latest Trading Status for each symbol/order book type pair will be sent during a Spin Request. When this message is received as part of a Spin Request, the Timestamp value will be set to 1 and should be ignored.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book to which the trading status applies.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current trading status code.

Field.Name: Trading Sub-Status
Field.Description: Current trading sub-status code.

Field.Name: Halt Reason
Field.Description: Reason code for a halt condition.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Represents a newly accepted order on Cboe Canada NEO. It includes a unique Order Id assigned by Cboe Canada NEO to the order.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the order was accepted.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Order side indicator.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the order book.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order.

Field.Name: Broker Id
Field.Description: Identity of trading Member that submitted the order (or 1 for anonymous).

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Settlement terms of the order.

Field.Name: Settlement Date
Field.Description: The date the order would settle.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: Reduce Size Message
Message.Description: Sent when a visible order on Cboe Canada NEO is partially reduced. Orders that are reduced in size do not lose priority.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the order resides.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Cancelled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares cancelled.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. An order that is deleted from the book may return to the book later. Therefore, a Delete Order message does not indicate that a given Order Id will not be sent again on a subsequent Add Order message. Members should be prepared to handle this scenario.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the order resided.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from order book.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. Modify Order messages appearing to be no ops will still lose priority.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the order resides.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Sent when a visible order on Cboe Canada NEO is executed in whole or in part. The execution price equals the order price found in the original Add Order message or the order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe Canada NEO generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution.

Field.Name: Buy Broker Id
Field.Description: Trading participant identity of the buyer of the trade (or 1 for anonymous).

Field.Name: Sell Broker Id
Field.Description: Trading participant identity of the seller of the trade (or 1 for anonymous).

Field.Name: Execution Flags
Field.Description: Execution flags bit field.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Provides information about executions of orders not displayed on any Cboe Canada trading book. Trade messages may also provide information about displayed orders that are traded at a price other than their displayed price. Trade messages do not alter the book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the trade occurred.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed or reported.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the trade.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe Canada NEO generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break and Trade Correction messages.

Field.Name: Buy Broker Id
Field.Description: Trading participant identity of the buyer of the trade (or 1 for anonymous).

Field.Name: Sell Broker Id
Field.Description: Trading participant identity of the seller of the trade (or 1 for anonymous).

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The type of the Cross order.

Field.Name: Trade Flags
Field.Description: Trade flags bit field.

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Settlement terms of the order.

Field.Name: Settlement Date
Field.Description: The date the order would settle.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an execution on Cboe Canada NEO is cancelled. Applications that simply build a Cboe Canada NEO book can ignore Trade Break messages.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the original execution occurred.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Original Quantity
Field.Description: Original number of shares executed or reported.

Field.Name: Original Price
Field.Description: Original price of the execution.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe Canada NEO generated day-unique identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an execution on Cboe Canada NEO is corrected. Applications that simply build a Cboe Canada NEO book can ignore Trade Correction messages.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the original execution occurred.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Original Quantity
Field.Description: Original number of shares executed or reported.

Field.Name: Original Price
Field.Description: Original price of the execution.

Field.Name: Original Settlement Type
Field.Description: Original settlement terms of the order.

Field.Name: Original Settlement Date
Field.Description: Original date the order would settle.

Field.Name: Corrected Quantity
Field.Description: Corrected number of shares executed or reported.

Field.Name: Corrected Price
Field.Description: Corrected price of the execution.

Field.Name: Corrected Settlement Type
Field.Description: Corrected settlement terms of the order.

Field.Name: Corrected Settlement Date
Field.Description: Corrected date the order would settle.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe Canada NEO generated day-unique identifier of the execution that was corrected. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Disseminates price and size information and Composite Market bid and offer prices during Opening Call, Closing Call, and reopening call (halt). Auction Update messages are sent during an auction period, unless in a delayed closing.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the auction occurs (3=NEO-L).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Midpoint of the BBO, or NLSP if entering a delayed closing (trading status 'M'). Not used ($0.00) for Opening Call and reopening call.

Field.Name: Imbalance Quantity
Field.Description: The size of the auction unmatched shares at the Reference Price (for the Closing Call). The size of the auction unmatched shares at the Indicative Price (for the Opening Call and reopening call).

Field.Name: Imbalance Side Indicator
Field.Description: The side of the auction imbalance at the Reference Price (for the Closing Call). The side of the auction imbalance at the Indicative Price (for the Opening Call and reopening call).

Field.Name: Matched Shares
Field.Description: The matched shares at the Reference Price (for the Closing Call). The matched shares at the Indicative Price (for the Opening Call and reopening).

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book and the continuous book would match.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: For the Closing Call: Price at which the Closing Call Book would match using only eligible auction orders. Not used for the Opening Call and reopening call.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Disseminates the results of an Opening Call, Closing Call, or reopening call (Halt) on Cboe Canada NEO. An Auction Summary message for each Cboe Canada Listed Security is sent at the conclusion of its Opening Call and represents the Cboe official Opening Price (or Closing Price).

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book on which the auction occurred (3=NEO-L).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (right padded with spaces).

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares executed during the auction.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: Sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No additional sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved (undefined).

Bitfield.Description: Defines the order book types allowed for the symbol. 0 means not allowed and 1 means allowed.

Field.Name: Reserved 0-2

Field.Name: NEO-N

Field.Name: NEO-D

Field.Name: Crossing Facility
Field.Description: Crossing Facility allowed.

Field.Name: SST

Field.Name: Closing Eligible
Field.Description: 0 = Not eligible, 1 = Eligible.

Field.Name: Reserved 2-7

Field.Name: Reserved 0
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Reserved 2-7
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Auction

Field.Name: Reserved 2-7
